conflicts.description: The selected exact 1.0.3 VPX is explicitly a UK model with All-Skill extra posts. The canonical record covers the shared 2004 physical product plus optional UK hardware, so common named playfield objects are promoted while Q33-Q35 and any UK-only geometry remain unresolved; no standard-machine coordinates are projected from the UK table.

The exact archived table's Q24 callback invokes a sound-only vpmsolsound routine, while the retained VPW v1.3 script comments out its Q24 SolKnocker callback. The Stern manual calls Q24 an optional unassigned 5 V output. The physical disposition is therefore no stock Q24 device, but the two table scripts are not behavior-identical for an optional external installation.

evidence_policy: Exact named VPX objects only; no standard-machine projection from the selected UK model; render helpers and collapsed multiplicity are withheld.

unresolved_blockers.blocker: The exact table's shared cvpmBallStack does not expose individual normalized seats for trough/stacking switches 11-15.
The visible lock path has Kicker.Lock and generic triggers but no exact per-seat public sensor mapping for contacts 44-46.
Q21's exact table exposes the vari-target assembly but no named reset-coil actuator center.
UK-only Q33-Q35 are physical optional posts, but the selected table supplies no named actuator geometry and standard-machine projection is prohibited.
The exact table does not expose named objects for matrix lamps 33-35 and 60-62.
The exact table collapses lamps 76-78 to one shared back-panel render anchor, so their three physical multiplicity positions are withheld.
Schema-v2 display records do not accept playfield placements; backbox/display surface positions remain documented in the manual and display inventory but are not spatially asserted.
